name: dsh-client-ui-hawk-media
description: Out-of-tree dsh plugin: media player for DSH. (1) In-chat: a video/audio named in a message (path or URL) becomes a native player with controls, right in the conversation. (2) In the right Sidebar: a document-preview type for video (mp4/m4v/webm/mov/ogv) and audio (mp3/m4a/wav/oga/ogg). Bytes are streamed from the plugin's own Range-capable route, because the built-in /api/file refuses anything over the 20 MiB image limit.
